title: Inspections of Licensed Cord Blood Banks and Support for Customers Affected by Recent Lapse at Commercial Cord Blood Bank
what_it_is: Inspections of Licensed Cord Blood Banks and Support for Customers Affected by Recent Lapse at Commercial Cord Blood Bank

sections.label: Cordlife incident regulatory review
sections.summary: MOH will review HCSA and cord blood banking regulations, including inspection frequency and monitoring, while advising clients to await investigation results before transferring units.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Arising from the Cordlife incident, MOH will review the regulatory requirements under the HCSA and the Healthcare Services (Cord Blood Banking Service) Regulations, including frequency of inspections and other aspects of inspections as well as the monitoring and reporting requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Many clients of Cordlife have approached MOH for assistance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Most have wanted Cordlife to rectify their shortcomings and this will be MOH's supervision priority as investigations are being conducted.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: MOH has also received enquiries about transferring cord blood units to another provider.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have engaged the other storage providers, who are prepared to assist.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: MOH has advised that clients wait for the investigation to complete, likely in a few weeks' time, before deciding whether to do so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Transferring cord blood units at ultra-low temperatures is a complex task and carries risks that are not insignificant.

sections.label: Annual inspection frequency review
sections.summary: A member asks whether inspections could be annual to prevent recurrence, and MOH says it is reviewing inspection frequency and type.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In view of this Cordlife incident, can we also explore to see if there are any possibilities of having it on an annual basis instead, to prevent the recurrence of this unfortunate incident?

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We are reviewing the regulatory requirements and so, one of the things that we will be reviewing is the frequency as well as the type of inspections, audits and review.
